citations.name: habeas:coverage
citations.commentary:
Formatting requires a value of the uninhabited UnreadContents type.
 This empty match has no executable case; storage tests deliberately
 supply no content values and reject node reads at the domain boundary.

rationale:
The `habeas:coverage` citation on `impl[UnreadContents/NodeContents]/fn[format]` in `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/support/stored_graph.rs` is a valid coverage-exception proposal.

- **Form:** It is a fenced citation commentary on an explicit function with a body, which is a permitted form. The explanation is substantive.
- **Agreement with the source:** `UnreadContents` is declared as `pub enum UnreadContents {}`, so it is uninhabited. `format` is `match *self {}`, which has no executable case, as the commentary says. The commentary's reliance on other code also holds. `StoredGraph::node_content`, the only place that would produce an `UnreadContents`, panics with "storage operations must not read graph contents". So no value can be supplied and node reads are rejected at the domain boundary.
- **Why it is acceptable:** The function cannot be executed at all, so zero execution is justified by the type, not by difficulty.
- **Other roles:** The item has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to the same target, so the citation is not redundant.
